landing.hero_subtitle: Upload your fencing video and get automatic pose estimation, technique classification, score tracking, and coaching insights.

landing.features_subtitle: Precision fencing analysis powered by cutting-edge computer vision and deep learning.
landing.feat_pose_desc: Real-time tracking of 17 joints with YOLO11-Pose. Analyze stance and footwork in detail.
landing.feat_action_desc: VideoMAE-based action recognition automatically classifies attacks, ripostes, counter-attacks, and remises.
landing.feat_score_desc: LED detection + 7-segment OCR for automatic score recognition. Generates touch-by-touch timelines.
landing.feat_insight_desc: Pattern analysis, weakness diagnosis, and training suggestions. Data-driven coaching support.
